python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,collections,os
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z']).decode().split('\0');c=collections.Counter();total=0;n=0;large=[]
for p in filter(None,files):
 size=os.path.getsize(p);total+=size;n+=1;c[p.split('/')[0]+'/'+(p.split('/')[1] if '/'in p else '')]+=1
 if size>1024*1024:large.append((size,p))
print('untracked',n,'bytes',total,'groups',c.most_common(8),'large',sorted(large,reverse=True)[:10])
PY
